race.description: Greg & Steve Norris Accountants Mdn Plate
race.comment: DR KNOW (6) is a Nicconi gelding on debut for the O'Shea & Charlton stable. Has impressed in his lead-up work and is expected to make a bright start. CREATOR OF WORLD (1) started at $1.85 but let backers down last time out when he found one better over 1450m at the Illawarra Grange circuit. In the money at both runs over 1200m here so worth another chance. Gai and Adrian's CONFUCIUS (5) debuts. By Zoustar and is a half-brother to dual Group 2 placegetter Anode. Trialling okay - the wide gate is the biggest concern. SKY DECK (18) returns for the Snowden camp and looks to have come on nicely during the break, stripping fitter for a Warwick Farm trial. Can play a role.
